data.one_liner: Renders A2UI surfaces as Flutter widgets from AI agent messages.
data.what_it_does: A2UI Flutter parses JSON-described user interfaces provided by AI agents and renders them using a basic catalog of Material components. It works alongside a2ui_core to handle message processing, state, actions, and data binding.
use_when: Your application needs to render dynamic user interfaces generated by an AI agent.
You are building an AI-driven app that streams interactive UI components via the A2UI protocol.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile application with a static, hardcoded UI structure.
You do not use AI agents or server-driven UI messaging protocols.
strengths: Allows AI models to define functional user interfaces dynamically.
Includes a basic catalog of Material components.
Supports custom component implementation and extensibility.
weaknesses: Requires careful security considerations when dealing with untrusted agent messages.
Network images and media on macOS require specific entitlements.
data.setup_notes: On macOS, network images and media need the com.apple.security.network.client entitlement. Add a2ui_flutter and a2ui_core to your pubspec.
